segments.text: Karin is the childhood friend of Atsu, Jun, Yume, Yurari and Seiji.

She has always been very close to Seiji, her best friend, and she never cried so much as the day he left 10 years ago. When the Kanou family moved back to town, Karin is the verry first to visit them, disguised as a superhero like when she played with Seiji when they were young.

She has a rather Deredere character and despite the fact that she is grown up and has become very attractive, she keeps some old tomboy habits. Very friendly, she makes friends very easily and quickly. It is thanks to all her qualities and her common passion for cats that she was able to become friends with Mitsu, a very pretty German student who has recently joined the school.
She doesn't trust at all in her feminine charms and she quickly loses her feet when Seiji compliments her.

When she was little, she played daddy and mommy with Seiji in their secret base and even made a plaque with their names on, as if they had been married. During the 10 years of his absence, she went there frequently to remind herself of those moments that she considers extremely precious.
She doesn't know why A-chan started to get away from her and Jin but she would like to get close to her again because she loves her a lot.
Karin is quite popular with other students in reality, some even suggest to her to show her feminine charms to Seiji so that he falls in love with her and they would finally go out together.
She has a diary she has been holding for years and where she has written a lot of embarrassing things inside, especially about her feelings for Seiji.
正司の幼馴染で学園の２年生。
快活で明るく、誰に対しても優しい。
正司と同じぐらいに面倒見が良く、男女問わずに友人が多い。
その上に可愛らしく、子供のように素直で、しかし子供以下のバカ。
悪口や嫌味を言われてもそれすら悪意として捉えないポジティブ……
というかやっぱりバカで素直。
正司とは小さい頃から「町の人助け隊」と称し、二人いっしょに他人の手伝いやらお節介を引き受けていた。
容貌や性格もあり、彼女に告白しようとする男子学生は多いが、そのいずれも断っている。
彼女自身はまだそういうことには興味はないとうそぶき、また周囲から彼女はお子様だから……とからかわれている状態。
しかし、その実はすでに好きな者――正司がいるからであり、幼い頃から思慕の気持ちを抱き続けている。
かなりガチな特撮マニア。
正司の幼なじみで学園の2年生。
快活で明るく、誰に対しても優しい。 正司と同じく面倒見が良く、男女問わずに友人が多い。
そのうえ可愛らしく、子供のように素直で、しかし子供以下のバカ。
悪口や嫌味を言われてもそれを悪意として捉えない、ポジティブ…というかやっぱりバカで素直。
正司とは小さい頃から “町の人助け隊” と称して、ふたり一緒に他人の手伝いやらお節介を引き受けていた。
容貌や性格もあり、彼女に告白しようとする男子学生は多いが、そのいずれも断っている。
まだそういうことには興味がないとうそぶき、また周囲からは 「彼女はお子様だから……」 とからかわれている状態。
しかしその実は、すでに好きな人――正司がいるからであり、幼い頃から思慕の気持ちを抱き続けている。
かなりガチな特撮マニア。
Atsu is the childhood friend of Karin, Jun, Yume, Yurari and Seiji and later the friend of Mitsu.

She is the head of the student council and is known for her rigor and severity. Because of her duty, she doesn't drag much with Karin and Jun, the distance is created between them and that makes her uncomfortable.

She looks extremely cold at first glance but in reality she is very kind and that is one of the reasons that explains her popularity. She is far from indifferent when she learns that Seiji is back, however she can not spend much time with him but she still finds a way to go to see him from president of the council to club president.

Of the three childhood friends of Seiji, she was the only one who hadn't moved to say goodbye to Seiji 10 years before, not because she didn't want it but because she was hurt (indirectly because of Seiji) because their secret base collapsed during an argument she had with Seiji when he told her he was moving. She also keeps a scar of that accident but it's hidden today by her rather generous chest.
If Seiji decides to spend some time with her, she reveals herself and gets closer to him and she confesses that she felt perhaps more than friendship to him 10 years before.

Her father is very traditional and is very attached to his daughter who is his only family, and she respects his will, that's why she doesn't want to have (penetrating) sex with Seiji as long as her father doesn't recognized him as her boyfriend.
正司の幼馴染で、学園の生徒会長。
性格は極めて生真面目で、かなりの堅物。
常に冷静沈着であり、人を寄せ付けない雰囲気を漂わせている。
ただ、予想外の出来事にはかなり弱く、アドリブが利かないばかりか、本人自身も後から考えてどうしてあんなことをしたのか……と思うぐらいに突飛な発言と行動を取ってしまう。
当然、彼女はこれらのマイナス面を隠そうと、日頃から常に厳しく感情を律しようとしている。
それがまた彼女の人を寄せ付けない雰囲気を強めているため、これといった友人がいない状況になっている。
町の旧家の一人娘であり、正司達とは昔からの顔見知りだが、子供の頃の遊びで大怪我をしたことから疎遠になっている。
正司の幼なじみで、学園の生徒会長。
性格は極めて生真面目でかなりの堅物。 常に冷静沈着であり、人を寄せ付けない雰囲気を漂わせている。
ただ、予想外の出来事にはかなり弱く、アドリブが利かないばかりか、本人も後から 「どうしてあんなことをしたのか……」 と思うぐらいに突飛な発言と行動をしてしまう。
当然、彼女はこれらのマイナス面を隠そうと、日頃から常に厳しく感情を律しようとしている。
それがまた彼女の人を寄せ付けない雰囲気を強めているため、友人がいない状況になっている。
町の旧家の一人娘であり、正司たちとは昔からの顔見知りだが、子供の頃の遊びで大怪我をしたことから疎遠になっている。
Yume is the younger sister of Seiji, the younger cousin of Yurari and the childhood friend of Karin, Jun and Atsu. Later, she becomes the friend of Mitsu.
She has a very fragile health and only goes out for her extended stays in the hospital. She spends most of her life confined to a room.

Exiting very rarely outside, Yume has developed an unmeasurable passion for programming. Often alone at home or with her mother, she has developed an instant conversation app (named UNI) so she can talk to anyone she loves at any moment.

Yume is romantically in love with Seiji because he has always taken care of her and has always prioritized her. She hopes that Seiji will one day be aware of her as a woman, but she is quite complexed because of her cousin Yurari, who often comes to their house, and who has a lot more assets than she so she treats her as her rival.
Yume is so talented in computer science that she has been noticed by some companies. She hopes to one day open her own business and earn a lot of money to benefit her family.

Yume's doctor found that she is sterile, only Yume's mother knows it and she is briefing Seiji because she is afraid of the day when neither she nor her husband will be able to take care of their little treasure and she asks Seiji to take over the day they disappear.
Her parents consider her as a small treasure: pretty, attractive, charming and bright but fragile.
正司の妹。
体が弱いため、学園に通ってはおらず、静養も含めて常に家にいる。
かなりの毒舌家で天邪鬼。
兄である正司をことあるごとにからかい、生意気な罰だとワガママを言っている。
ただそれは夢のさびしさの裏返し。
正司に対して我侭を言うのは一人でいるさびしさを埋め、できるかぎり彼といっしょにいたいがため、無理難題を言って二人でいる時間を延ばしているのである。
だからこそ、夢にとって正司はかけがけないの肉親であると共に、唯一好意を向けることができ、またそれを裏切られることのない存在――つまりは恋愛対象となっている。
正司を独占したいため、他の幼馴染達に嫉妬している。
正司の妹。
身体が弱いため学園に通っておらず、いつも家で静養している。
かなりの毒舌家で天邪鬼。 兄である正司をことあるごとにからかい、生意気な罰だとワガママばかり言っている。
ただ、それは夢の寂しさの裏返し。
ワガママを言うのは出来る限り兄と一緒の時間を過ごし、独りでいる時の寂しさを埋めるため。
無理難題を言っては二人でいる時間を延ばしているのである。
だからこそ、夢にとって正司はかけがえのない肉親であるとともに、唯一好意を向けることができ、またそれを裏切られることのない存在―― つまり恋愛対象となっている。
正司を独占したいため、他の幼なじみたちに嫉妬している
Yurari is the older cousin of Seiji and Yume and the childhood friend of Karin, Jun and Atsu and the friend of Mitsu. She is also their teacher.

Yurari is currently learning to be a teacher, it's her childhood dream. She tends to speak slowly while taking breaks with her friends but begins to speak normally in front of the rest of the world. She is very close to Seiji since always, always to cuddle him as if he was a plush, their proximity is such that Seiji once confessed his feelings but she never gave him an answer.
She is idolized by the whole school where she works, but she doesn't know why.
She has a lifestyle that is usually completely neglected, she only wears tracksuits, does not tidy her apartment and Seiji greets with just a towel to cover herself.
She hardly feels shame, being naked in front of Seiji doesn't bother her.
Whether Yume or Seiji or whoever else, everyone thinks that she is not a virgin since a long time, because she is very pretty and very kind.
She is very assertive, when Seiji decides to take an interest in Yurari again, it is she who takes the lead by masturbating him in the bathroom.
幼馴染の一人で、正司の従姉。
彼が転校する学園に勤めている非常勤講師。
学園に頼まれ、動画部の顧問を務めることになる。
非常にマイペースで、授業以外では無口で無表情。
漂う雰囲気はぼーっとした眠たげで、気だるいもの。
行動力もあり才色兼備と完璧な彼女だが、その寡黙さと、そして喋ったとしても微妙にズレたセリフのため、ここぞというときに外してしまう残念な部分を持っている。
正司のことを溺愛しており、言葉を発しない分常にベタベタと過度なスキンシップをしてくる。
正司の従姉で、幼なじみの一人。
学園に勤めている非常勤講師で、正司たち動画部の顧問を務めることになる。
非常にマイペースで、授業以外では無口・無表情。 漂う雰囲気は、ぼーっとした眠たげで気だるいもの。
行動力があり才色兼備と完璧な彼女だが、その寡黙さと、そして喋ったとしても微妙にズレたセリフのため、ここぞという時に外してしまう残念な部分を持っている。
正司のことを溺愛しており、言葉を発しない分、常にベタベタと過度なスキンシップをしてくる。

segments.text: Mitsu is a new student and already has a poor reputation in the school. She is quite cold and dry with people talking to her.

She meets Seiji and Karin one day on the way to school, trying to get a little cat stuck in a tree but without success. When Seiji and Karin offer her help, she categorically refuses and tries to climb the tree to retrieve the little cat. However, she stumbles and falls on Seiji's head who wanted to catch her but...
Her inner parties are found on the mouth of Seiji who made her an involuntary proto-cunnilingus that excit... angry and embarrassed her enormously.
Nevertheless, thanks to Karin, the misunderstanding is quickly settled and the two girls and Seiji become friends. They will introduce her later to others so that she becomes their friend too.
Mitsu is a typical Coodere; she is in fact super adorable but she shows this trait of her personality only to the people she appreciates.

She doesn't have any confidence in herself, more than Karin. She thinks nothing is attractive in her and she hates her personality. This hatred she feels for herself even gives her the feeling that no one can feel love for her.

Sometimes she speaks German when she says "Guten Morgen" (Good Morning) or "Ja" (Yes) but speaks Japanese for more complex sentences. However, she speaks fully in German when she loses balance (emotionally speaking).
She comes from a very wealthy family but she doesn't boast about it at all and doesn't even show it.
正司の学園に転校してきた女の子。２年生。
外国人とのハーフであり、まるでビスクドールか妖精のような端正かつ愛くるしい容貌を持っているが、その性格はまるで逆。
かなり高飛車で傲慢で我侭であり、人は全て自分に従うものだとうそぶく。
しかし、それは人見知りと照れを誤魔化すためのものであり、悪態をつくたびに後悔し、自己嫌悪に陥り、落ち込んでいる。
転校続きであったため、子供の頃からの友人がいない。
そのため幼馴染というものに憧れを抱いている。
正司と同じく学園に転校してきた女の子。 2年生。
外国人とのハーフであり、まるでビスクドールか妖精のような端正かつ愛くるしい容貌を持っているが、その性格はまるで逆。
かなり高飛車で傲慢でワガママであり、人はすべて自分に従うものだとうそぶく。
しかし、それは人見知りと照れを誤魔化すためのものであり、悪態をつくたびに後悔し、自己嫌悪に陥り、落ち込んでいる。
転校続きであったため、子供の頃からの友人がいない。
そのため幼なじみというものに憧れを抱いている。
Seiji is the older brother of Yume, the younger cousin of Yurari (who is also his first crush) and the childhood friend of Karin, Jun and Atsu and the friend of Mitsu.

He moved with his parents 10 years ago and lost all contact with his childhood friends because there were no cell phones at the time he left. He recently came to live with his family in the city of his childhood and is quite happy that almost nothing has really changed.

After Karin shows him his new school and reintroduce Jin (who has change a lot physicaly and who has now has a girlfriend), Seiji is given the head of their new club based on new technologies, however, for the club to be recognized, Seiji must first find a teacher advisor of the club and then ask permission from the strict student council president, who is none other than Atsu, who has moved away from Karin and Jun during Seiji's absence.

Having found a teacher in the person of his cousin Yurari, Seiji must now convince Atsu first to allow the opening of the club and secondly to convince her to join the club so they are finally all together...
The overprotective father of Atsu. He lost his wife sometime after the birth of his daughter and he has been educating him since. His personality is surprisingly surprising.

He is particularly angry at Seiji for the accident of 10 years ago and when he learns that he and his daughter have become more than friends, his protective paternal instinct is doubly on the move in order to intimidate him as much as possible against the one who wants to take away his daughter from him.

When Seiji goes out with Atsu, they will spend an evening with Atsu's father in which he heavily abused alcohol. Thinking he was in a deep sleep, Seiji and Atsu make love, but he wakes up because he wants to pee and he surprises the two love birds at the very end of their act. He then congratulates his daughter for her futur baby (always drunk), which makes Seiji laugh a lot.
The mother of Seiji and Yume and the aunt of Yurari.
She works very hard for the good of her husband and children. She is very attentive to the needs of her daughter and she relies heavily on her son to take care of Yume.

Yume's doctor found that she is sterile, only Yume's mother knows it and she is briefing Seiji because she is afraid of the day when neither she nor her husband will be able to take care of their little treasure and she asks Seiji to take over the day they will disappear.
The father of of Seiji and Yume and the uncle of Yurari.
He works very hard for the good of his wife and children.
The cat that finds Seiji, Karin and Mitsu.
He was adopted by Karin and Mitsu often visits him.
Seiji, married to Atsu, 20 years later. He is now a dad of a big girl and a little boy.
He and Atsu decide to show to their children the place where they started their love story.
Jun is Ryoshiko's boyfriend and the childhood friend of of Atsu, Karin, Yume, Yurari and Seiji. Later, he becomes the friend of Mitsu.

He and Ryoshiko know each other from the middle school but they did not talk to each other before. Jun only noticed her in high school during a painting class because he had been hypnotized by her concentration. He had asked her to go out with him soon after.
He is quite cool and friendly, and very much in love with Ryoshiko.
He is among the few students who do not idolize Yoshino-sensei because he already idolizes Ryoshiko.
He is very good advice when Seiji is confused with his feelings.
Ryoshiko is Jun's girlfriend and a friend of Karin. Later, she becomes the friend of Mitsu, Atsu, Yume, Yurari and Seiji.

She and Jun know each other from the middle school but they did not talk to each other before. Jun only noticed her in high school during a painting class because he had been hypnotized by her concentration. He had asked her to go out with him soon after.
She is shy and does not dare to impose herself during conversations. It is often Jun who put it forward by exposing the countless quality she has.
She idolizes and has an incredible admiration for Yoshino-sensei, like all the rest of the students and professors of the school.
Atsu, married to Seiji, 20 years later. She is now a mother of a big girl and a little boy.
She and Seiji decide to show to their children the place where they started their love story.
She is the eldest daughter of Seiji and Atsu, as she is 20 years after Seiji's return to town.
She and her younger brother discover the secret base of their parents, the place where their relationship of childhood friends has become a loving relationship.
He is the youngest son of Seiji and Atsu, as he is 20 years after Seiji's return to town.
He and his older sister discover the secret base of their parents, the place where their relationship of childhood friends has become a loving relationship.
